experiments.title: Mistype one person's name in the access system
experiments.plain: FC-00002 Rue Tallowmere becomes "Rue Tallowmare" in this month's access roster.
experiments.predict: Same member id, slightly different name. Is that a new person, a change, or nothing?
experiments.look_for: A note reports that FC-00002's name differs between the access system and the approval. Access is not changed - the id matches - but a person is told. (This experiment found that the drift used to pass silently; the note and its test were added.)

experiments.title: Someone disappears from the access system
experiments.plain: FC-00004 Ivo Dunmarrow is deleted from this month's access roster but is still approved.
experiments.predict: Should the approved roster drop them automatically?
experiments.look_for: The pipeline proposes ADD FC-00004 - the access system must match what was approved, so an approved person who disappeared is put back, not dropped.
